howTo: Daily Offices in the menu are the entries below that have an href. Morning and evening wording is site/_includes/office.njk. Spoken Rite II is site/_includes/rite-ii.njk. A new language lists its pages here and adds a template beside office.njk. Lesson citations stay in site/_data/daily_office.json.

offices.label: Today's Office: Readings Only
offices.next: Psalms and lessons for the date, without the prayers. The live readings page is the model: Morning Psalms, Evening Psalms, Old Testament, New Testament, Gospel.

offices.label: Compline
offices.next: This is the prayer-book rite at /compline/. A dated Compline is a new template next to site/_includes/office.njk plus a permalink of its own. The old app returned one of four sentences at random. Those sentences are not a page in this build.

offices.label: Noonday Prayer
offices.next: Noonday has no page in this build. Add site/_includes/noonday.njk, give this entry an href, and add a page template under site/.

languages.name: Español
languages.note: Spanish collects, prefaces, and canticles are published. Spanish morning and evening prayer are not.
languages.next: Add site/_includes/office-es.njk for the spoken text. The lesson citations in daily_office.json are the English book names either way. Contemporary Spanish prefaces are already in site/_data/prefaces_contemporary_es.json; add a row to site/_data/prefacePages.js with which set to CES to publish them.
